items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: Whitney and I stayed quite a bit in touch until his death, you know?

ctx.x: Yeah, he was in -- I think he was in sociology. I think so. I'm not sure, because we all stayed in the dormitory, you know. One thing I remember, after I'd been to Englewood High School and had had physics and chemistry and all that, I used to go and help -- excuse me --

Whitney with his physical science. See by that time they'd begun to combine the classes. It was physical science. But when I was going to school you took botany was one course, and zoology was another course, so you were thoroughly educated on it, you know? Whitney and I stayed quite a bit in touch until his death, you know? We felt a little proud of each other after leaving the campus.
